_comment: Campaign config template for scripts/postprocess_report.py — a NEW two-day campaign (one tracking day + one engagement day) with a radar rollup. Structure copied from seawall_week_0824.json (the real 8/24 campaign). Replace every <PLACEHOLDER>; keys starting with '_comment' are ignored by the code (every read is .get()), but do NOT put them inside fixed-length list rows (flights_pdt triples, steal_examples 5-tuples, init.day, ant). Numeric placeholders (<ANT_LAT> etc.) MUST become numbers, not strings, before running. Run: cd skills/seawall-post-analysis/scripts && micromamba run -n sensorenv python postprocess_report.py <this file>. See references/campaign-config.md for every key.

_comment_placeholders.<CAMPAIGN>: short slug for the report dir, e.g. seawall_week_0914
_comment_placeholders.<DATE1>/<DATE2>: YYYY-MM-DD of the tracking / engagement day (day ids MUST be dates for the standalone link rewrite)
_comment_placeholders.<RUN8_A>/<RUN8_B>: first 8 hex of the run collection for each day
_comment_placeholders.<DUMP_DIR_A>/<DUMP_DIR_B>: dump dirs written by scripts/dump_run_window.py (<root>/<YYYY-MM-DD>/<run8>_<label>/ with mavlink/, tracks/, meta.json; old quickdump / archiver dumps are still readable). Instead of a 'dump' path any day / prep / engagement / radar_rollup day may carry a 'mongo' spec (see _comment_mongo) and the pipeline dumps it first.
_comment_placeholders.<ANT_LAT>,<ANT_LON>,<ANT_HAE_M>: per-deployment antenna origin from the dump's meta.json 'antenna' (or 'antenna_origin_lat_lon_haeM') — NEVER reuse another day's
_comment_placeholders.<GEOID_N>: site HAE-minus-MSL in metres (Seawall = -31.4). Must match corr_lib.GEOID_N used when the dump was written
_comment_placeholders.<TARGET_CSV>: target truth csv name or glob in <dump>/mavlink/, e.g. mav14550_1_1.csv or mav*_1_*.csv (ls the dir — the compid suffix changes). Set once at the top level; per-day / per-engagement 'target_pattern' overrides
_comment_placeholders.<INTERCEPTOR_GLOB>: interceptor truth glob, e.g. mav14551_2_*.csv (several compids are merged). Top-level default, per-day / per-engagement override
_comment_placeholders.<HH:MM:SS>: LOCAL clock strings in the campaign 'tz' (DST-aware zoneinfo; default America/Los_Angeles = PDT/PST as appropriate)
_comment_placeholders.<TRACK_ID>: radar track id alive at the featured pass (from flights.json tracking.target_track_spans)
_comment_placeholders.<TZ>: IANA timezone of the site, e.g. America/Los_Angeles, America/Denver, Europe/Berlin

title: Seawall Week of <M-DD> — Campaign Report
sub: MRU<MRU> · <DATE1> → <DATE2> · standard post-process pipeline: per-day reports from the two canonical modules, stitched into this rollup
_comment_tz: IANA zone for EVERY clock string in this file (flights_pdt, window_pdt, cpa_seed_pdt, t_steal_pdt, t_pdt) and for every printed time; DST-aware. Default when absent: America/Los_Angeles.
_comment_patterns: campaign-wide truth-file globs (relative to <dump>/mavlink/). Used by tracking prep, every engagement (unless target.pattern / interceptor_pattern is given there), the radar rollup (target = LARGEST match), steal/corruption views and turn_zoom. Legend ids are derived from the files actually matched. Defaults when absent: mav14550_1_1.csv / mav14551_2_*.csv (rollup: biggest mav14550*.csv).
_comment_dump_root: where 'mongo' day inputs are dumped by dump_run_window.py (default <out_root>/dumps)

_comment_mongo._comment: OPTIONAL live-unit input instead of 'dump' (valid on a day, a tracking 'prep', an engagement, a radar_rollup day, steal/corruption views, turn_zoom). The pipeline runs scripts/dump_run_window.py with exactly these keys, then continues offline and writes the resolved dir back into 'dump'. An existing complete dump under <root>/<day>/<run8>_<label>/ is reused (add "overwrite": true to re-dump).
_comment_mongo._comment_keys: mru (-> 10.1NN.28.205) or host; run = hex prefix | run_<hex> | friendly name | latest; jobs 'A-B' OR t0/t1 local time ('YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM[:SS]', or bare 'HH:MM' placed on the day's id/date); label -> folder <run8>_<label>; optional root, geoid_n, antenna [lat,lon,hae], no_adsb, no_obs, overwrite, port, db, chunk_s, max_track_range_m

_comment_out_root: out_root MUST live under the :8899 http.server root (VP_TrackAnalysis/mru91_track2895) and server_base must be its URL; optionally symlink <WEEK_ROOT>/reports/<CAMPAIGN>_report -> out_root
_comment_rollup_html:
HTML appended under the auto-built Days card table in the Overall Rollup tab: the campaign in one arc (8/24 used one

+ one

).

days._comment: TRACKING day. Uses prep (synthesise mission inputs from the dump) — never bare 'mdir' (that selects the hard-coded 8/26 MRU91 structure). flights_pdt takes 1..N flight windows (one fast2_F<n>.npz each); flight_keys F<n>R1 (or F<n>R<lap> with laps_pdt). The antenna is REQUIRED for a new site: init.ant (+ prep.ant_hae_m = init.ant[2]); when omitted the build reads the dump's meta.json antenna and prints a WARN, and only falls back to the MRU91 default with a loud warning.
days.title: <M/D> — Tracking (2 flights)

prep._comment_flights_pdt: from flights.json t0_pdt/t1_pdt (local clock in 'tz'); ONE row per flight, any number of flights.
prep._comment_gate_m: constant: track median-distance-to-truth gate (m) for FLIGHT_TRACKS; 350 is the standard
prep._comment_laps_pdt: OPTIONAL lap windows keyed '<flight>,<lap>' -> one 'Flight N · Lap N' tab each (list them in flight_keys as F<flight>R<lap>); without it every flight is one lap (F<n>R1).
prep._comment_target_pattern: optional per-day override of the top-level target_pattern (glob; the LARGEST match is the truth file)

days._comment_notes_html:
NARRATIVE (analyst): one

Key message: ... ...

(+ optional
    ) describing az bias, coverage, error, continuity for this day. Empty -> a 'not yet written' placeholder renders (prep days never fall back to the 8/26 text). The Summary

    and the per-lap window line are computed from the data.
days._comment_key_message_html: Rollup card column 2, e.g. 'Cal applied — residual az −0.4°; 25 m corrected; continuity association-limited'
days._comment_numbers_html:
Rollup card column 3, e.g. 'Az bias: −0.4°
Coverage: 90%
Median error: 40 m'

days._comment: ENGAGEMENT day. One entry per featured pass. All clock strings resolve on 'date' in the campaign 'tz'. 'ant' is REQUIRED for a new site (else meta.json antenna with a WARN). Each engagement may carry its own 'dump' or 'mongo'; interceptor_pattern / target.pattern default to the top-level patterns; legend ids come from the truth files actually loaded. A 'fov' block is optional — missing ulog/video/ffmpeg skips ONLY the FOV section with a console note.
days.title: <M/D> — Engagements (<N> flights)
days._comment_ant: three numbers from THIS day's meta.json antenna (per-deployment)
days._comment_overview_html: optional: non-empty adds a leading 'Overview' tab with this HTML; '' -> no Overview tab

engagements.name: <M/D> Flight 1 — pass <n> (<HH:MM:SS> PDT)

target._comment: alternative when the MAVLink truth froze: {"traj_csv": "/abs/onboard_gps_traj.csv"} with columns utc_s,lat,lon,alt_hae_m

engagements._comment_window_pdt: whole flight/engagement window (drives truth loading and the Overview figure), not just the pass
engagements._comment_cpa_seed_pdt: from flights.json passes[].t_pdt; refined by eng_plots.cpa within +-20 s
engagements.summary_html: Key message: ... Closest approach {cpa_truth:.0f} m truth-truth, {cpa_track:.0f} m to track {track_id}.
engagements._comment_summary_html: only {cpa_truth} {cpa_track} {track_id} are substituted; any other {brace} raises KeyError

fov._comment: OPTIONAL — delete this whole 'fov' block when there is no interceptor ulog + IR video. zoff = flight-controller clock offset in seconds measured by position xcorr vs truth (8/27: 36002.0; 8/28: 36001.3-36001.8). Use EITHER cam{fps,onset_frame} (frame 0 anchored to ulog takeoff) OR camwarp npz.

days._comment_numbers_html:
e.g. 'Best CPA: 21 m
Passes <75 m: 10 of 23
Track steals: 3'

radar_rollup._comment: Every numeric figure here is computed at build time from 'days[].dirs'; only the *_html narratives and the example pointers are authored. The target csv in each dir MUST match mavlink/mav14550*.csv (toxic_zones.pick_truth_csvs). Omit 'az_bias_example' (it requires the legacy 8/26 mission dir).
radar_rollup._comment_az_bias_html: section 1 narrative; 8/24 embedded a <table class='st'> of day / azimuth bias / state here

days.label: <M/D tracking day>
days._comment: scoreable day: all dump dirs of the day (merged). For a non-scoreable day use {"label": ..., "scoreable": false, "note": "...", "az_bias_cfg": -2.2}

radar_rollup._comment_cells: constants used by the 8/24 report (heat-map cell size m, min truth samples per cell)
steal_examples: <what happened: STOLEN by the interceptor / dragged and died / handover gap>
radar_rollup._comment_steal_examples: narrative table rows [day, run, track, time, what] — fixed 5 elements, no _comment inside; delete rows you cannot back with data

steal_views.label: Track steal — trk <TRACK_ID> · run <RUN8_B> · <M/D> Flight 1, pass <n> (<HH:MM:SS> PDT)
steal_views._comment: animated +-10 s 2-D view + distance-duel plot; gif defaults to figs/steal_<track_id>.gif and is CACHED (delete to re-render). Remove this list entry if the campaign had no steal.

corruption_views.label: Track corruption — trk <TRACK_ID> · run <RUN8_B> · <M/D> Flight 1 (<HH:MM:SS> PDT)
corruption_views._comment: same loader as steal_views plus the az/el/range/alt error window +-12 s around t_steal_pdt. Remove if not needed.

turn_zoom.label: The far <NE> turn — run <RUN8_A> · trk <DYING_TRACK_ID> † <HH:MM:SS> PDT
turn_zoom._comment: ONE zoomed figure of a track dying in a turn (first id = the dying track, checked for death within +3 s of t_pdt). Delete the whole block if there is no such event.
